integrity: All stated finite counts are exhaustively verified by two standalone algorithms; the explicit labeled self-isomorphism is included in certificate.json. Publication priority and independent mathematical validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result covers exactly GP(8,3) and three-edge-colorings modulo global color permutation, with self-switches suppressed. It does not classify the 120-vertex graph of named colors or an infinite family. Complete finite enumeration is not an infinite proof. Historical priority beyond inspected primary literature remains unverified.
title: The Möbius–Kantor graph recurs as a component of its edge-Kempe reconfiguration graph
